title: 专科诊所来电改复诊时间
titleEn: The specialist's rooms call to reschedule
scene: 周五早上，你接到一个电话：是 Parkside Specialist Centre（专科诊所）的前台 Mel。你下周三约了 Dr Patel 的复诊，但医生那周休假，她要帮你改时间；她还会告诉你：GP 开的转诊信（referral）已经过了 12 个月有效期。
你的目标：① 听清她给的日期和时间，选一个不影响送孩子上学的时段；② 搞清楚要不要找 GP 重开转诊信、怎么发给诊所；③ 问清自付多少、Medicare 能退多少、取消规则。

vocab.zh: 专科医生诊所（澳洲常说 rooms）
vocab.ex: I'm calling from Dr Patel's rooms at Parkside Specialist Centre.
Dr Patel's away that week, so we've gotta move you.
Can we bring it forward a week, or push it back to the afternoon?
She reckons she can squeeze you in at eight forty.

vocab.zh: 取消候补名单（有人取消就通知你）
vocab.ex: I can pop you on the cancellation list if you like.

vocab.zh: 转诊信（GP 开给专科的）
vocab.ex: Your referral's run out, so you'll need a new one.
It was only good for twelve months, so it's run out.
It's a hundred and sixty upfront on the day.
You're out of pocket about seventy-five dollars.
We can do the Medicare claim for you on the day.
It's a follow-up, so it's shorter than the first one.

vocab.zh: 提前 48 小时通知 / 取消费
vocab.ex: We need forty-eight hours' notice, otherwise there's a cancellation fee.

listening.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Mel calling from Dr Patel's rooms. How're you going?
listening.sound: is that → "izzat"；How're you going → "How-ya-goin'?"（问好，不是问你去哪）
listening.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Dr Patel 诊所的 Mel。你好吗？

listening.en: Dr Patel's gonna be away that week, so we've gotta move you, sorry about that.
listening.sound: gonna = going to；we've gotta → "we've godda"（t 浊化成轻 d）
listening.zh: Patel 医生那周不在，所以得给你改时间，不好意思。
listening.reply: No worries. What other times have you got?

listening.en: I've got a ten-forty on the twenty-first, or there's a quarter past two the week after.
listening.sound: a ten-forty = 一个 10:40 的号；quarter past two = 2:15；数字连在一起说得很快
listening.zh: 21 号有个 10:40 的号，或者下一周有个 2:15 的。
listening.reply: Sorry, was that ten forty on the twenty-first?

listening.en: Your referral's run out. It was only good for twelve months, so you'll need to grab a new one off your GP.
listening.sound: referral's = referral has；good for = 有效期是；grab one off your GP = 找 GP 拿一份
listening.zh: 你的转诊信过期了，只有 12 个月有效，你得找 GP 重开一份。
listening.reply: Oh, I see. Can my GP email it to you?

listening.en: It's a hundred and sixty upfront, you'll get around eighty-five back, so you're out of pocket about seventy-five.
listening.sound: a hundred and sixty → "a hundred n sixty"；get around → "ged-around"
listening.zh: 当天先付 160，大概能退 85，自付大约 75。
listening.reply: So I pay one-sixty on the day and get about eighty-five back?

listening.en: I'll just pop you on hold for a sec while I check with her.
listening.sound: pop you on hold = 让你稍等（电话保持）；for a sec = 一下下
listening.zh: 我先让你稍等一下，我去问问医生。

speech.topic: 讲讲你在澳洲是怎么处理看医生/预约这件事的，有没有踩过坑？（第一人称）
paragraphs: Today I want to talk about how I handle medical appointments here in Adelaide.

When I first moved to Australia, the health system was quite confusing for me. In my home country, I could go straight to a hospital and see a specialist. Here, it works differently. First, you see a GP, and if you need a specialist, the GP writes you a referral.

I didn't know that a referral only lasts for twelve months. Last year, I turned up to a specialist appointment, and the receptionist told me my referral had run out. I had to pay the full fee, and I couldn't claim anything back from Medicare. That was a lesson for me.

Now I'm much more organised. I keep all our appointments in one calendar on my phone, including my kid's check-ups. When I book a specialist, I always ask three questions: how much it costs upfront, how much I'll get back from Medicare, and what the cancellation policy is.

The hardest part for me is still the phone calls. Receptionists often speak very fast, and they say dates and times quickly, like "a ten-forty on the twenty-first". I used to just say "yes" even when I wasn't sure. Now I ask them to slow down, or I repeat the details back to check. Most people are really friendly about it.
My tip for anyone new to Australia is simple: don't be shy to ask again. It's much better to ask twice than to turn up on the wrong day, or with the wrong paperwork.
speech.zh: 我想聊聊在阿德莱德怎么处理看医生的预约。刚来澳洲时，医疗系统让我很困惑：在国内可以直接去医院看专科，这里要先看 GP，需要专科时由 GP 开转诊信。我不知道转诊信只有 12 个月有效。去年去看专科时，前台说我的转诊信过期了，我只能付全款，Medicare 一分都退不了，算是买了个教训。现在我更有条理了：全家的预约都放在手机日历里，包括孩子的检查。预约专科时我一定问三件事：当天先付多少、Medicare 退多少、取消规则是什么。对我来说最难的还是电话：前台说得很快，日期时间一口气说完。以前没听清也会说 yes，现在我会请对方慢一点，或者把细节复述一遍确认。大多数人都很友好。给新来澳洲的人一个建议：别不好意思再问一遍，问两次总比去错日子、带错材料强。

patterns.en: When I first moved to Australia, ___ was quite confusing for me.
patterns.zh: 刚来澳洲时，___ 让我很困惑。（换成：the school system / renting a house / tax returns）

patterns.en: I didn't know that ___. That was a lesson for me.
patterns.zh: 我不知道 ___，算是买了个教训。
现在我在 ___ 之前一定会 ___。

patterns.en: My tip for anyone new to ___ is simple: ___.
patterns.zh: 给刚接触 ___ 的人一个简单建议：___。

lines.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Mel calling from Dr Patel's rooms at Parkside Specialist Centre. How're you going?
lines.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Parkside 专科中心 Dr Patel 诊所的 Mel。你好吗？

lines.en: Hi Mel, I'm good, thanks. How are you?
lines.zh: 你好 Mel，我挺好的，谢谢。你呢？

lines.en: Yeah, not bad, thanks. Look, I'm just ringing about your appointment on Wednesday the fourteenth. Unfortunately Dr Patel's gonna be away that week, so we've gotta move you. Sorry about that.
lines.zh: 嗯，还不错，谢谢。是这样，我打电话是关于你 14 号周三的预约。很遗憾 Patel 医生那周不在，所以得给你改时间。不好意思。

lines.en: Oh, OK. No problem. What other times do you have?
lines.zh: 哦，好的，没问题。还有什么别的时间？

lines.en: So I've got a ten-forty on Wednesday the twenty-first, or there's a quarter past two on Tuesday the twenty-seventh. Otherwise it's not till mid-November, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 我这边有 21 号周三上午 10:40，或者 27 号周二下午 2:15。不然就要等到 11 月中了。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? I didn't catch the times.
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍、慢一点吗？我没听清时间。

lines.en: Yeah, no worries. Ten forty in the morning, Wednesday the twenty-first. Or two fifteen in the afternoon, Tuesday the twenty-seventh.
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。21 号周三上午 10:40，或者 27 号周二下午 2:15。

lines.en: The afternoon one is a bit hard, because I have to pick up my kid from school. Is there anything early in the morning, like before nine?
lines.zh: 下午那个有点难，因为我要去学校接孩子。有没有早上早一点的，比如九点前？

lines.en: Hmm, she doesn't usually start till half eight... Hang on, I'll just pop you on hold for a sec and check with her.
lines.zh: 嗯，她一般八点半才开始……稍等，我先让你等一下，我去问问她。

lines.en: Sure, thank you.
lines.zh: 好的，谢谢。

lines.en: Thanks for holding. She reckons she can squeeze you in at eight forty on the twenty-first. Would that work for you?
lines.zh: 谢谢你等。她说 21 号早上 8:40 可以给你加个号。这个时间可以吗？

lines.en: Eight forty on the twenty-first. Yes, that works. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 21 号 8:40。可以，太感谢了。

lines.en: Lovely. Now, while I've got you, I was just looking at your file, and your referral's actually run out. It was only good for twelve months, so you'll need to grab a new one off your GP before you come in.
lines.zh: 好的。另外趁着跟你通话，我刚看了你的档案，你的转诊信其实已经过期了。它只有 12 个月有效，所以来之前你得找 GP 重新开一份。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean I need a new referral letter from my GP before the twenty-first?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，你是说 21 号之前我需要 GP 开一封新的转诊信？

lines.en: Yep, spot on. Otherwise you won't get anything back from Medicare. Your GP can email it straight to us, or fax it through, whatever's easier.
lines.zh: 对，没错。不然 Medicare 一分钱都不退。你的 GP 可以直接发邮件给我们，或者传真过来，哪个方便都行。

lines.en: OK. Could you spell the email address for me, please?
lines.zh: 好的。你能把邮箱地址拼给我吗？

lines.en: Sure. It's reception at parksidespec dot com dot au. That's P-A-R-K-S-I-D-E, then S-P-E-C.
lines.zh: 可以。是 reception@parksidespec.com.au，拼写是 P-A-R-K-S-I-D-E，然后 S-P-E-C。

lines.en: Got it. And how much will it cost? Is it the same as last time?
lines.zh: 记下了。那费用是多少？跟上次一样吗？

lines.en: So it's a follow-up, so it's a hundred and sixty upfront, and you'll get around eighty-five back from Medicare, so you're out of pocket about seventy-five. We can do the claim for you on the day if you bring your Medicare card.
lines.zh: 这是复诊，当天先付 160，Medicare 大概退 85，所以你自付大约 75。如果你带 Medicare 卡，当天我们可以帮你报销。

lines.en: Sorry, so I pay one-sixty on the day, and I get about eighty-five back?
lines.zh: 不好意思，所以我当天付 160，然后大概退 85，对吗？

lines.en: That's right. It goes straight back into your bank account, usually within a day or two.
lines.zh: 对。钱会直接退到你的银行账户，一般一两天内到。

lines.en: Great. Will I get a reminder?
lines.zh: 太好了。会有提醒吗？

lines.en: Yeah, you'll get a text two days before. Just reply Y to confirm. And if anything comes up, give us a ring. We just need forty-eight hours' notice, otherwise there's a cancellation fee.
lines.zh: 会的，提前两天会发短信给你，回复 Y 确认就行。如果临时有事给我们打电话，我们需要提前 48 小时通知，不然要收取消费。

lines.en: OK, no worries. So it's eight forty, Wednesday the twenty-first, and I'll ask my GP to email the new referral.
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。那就是 21 号周三 8:40，我会请 GP 把新转诊信发邮件过去。

lines.en: Perfect. Thanks, Amy. Have a good weekend!
lines.zh: 完美。谢谢你 Amy，周末愉快！

lines.en: Thanks, you too. Bye!
lines.zh: 谢谢，你也是。拜拜！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say the date and time again, a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能再慢一点说一下日期和时间吗？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, that's eight forty on Wednesday the twenty-first?
rescue.zh: 我确认一下，是 21 号周三 8:40 对吗？

rescue.en: Could you spell that for me, please?
Would you mind texting me the details, just so I have them in writing?
rescue.zh: 能把细节发短信给我吗？我想留个书面记录。

rescue.en: I'm in a meeting right now. Could I call you back in ten minutes?
rescue.zh: 我现在在开会，十分钟后回你电话可以吗？

checklist: 我听懂了 Mel 给的两个时间（10:40 / 2:15）和最后定的 8:40
我知道 referral 过期是什么意思、要怎么处理
我用了至少 2 次礼貌追问（say that again / just to confirm）
我能说出 upfront、out of pocket、rebate 的区别
2 分钟演讲我讲满了，中间停顿不超过 3 秒
我最后把关键信息复述了一遍（日期 + 要做的事）
